dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: We're free agents now, right? Great. Well, I think I'll stick around here for a bit, you wanna join me?

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Hmm... Actually, this is a pretty nice place. If I brought some of my people here, I'm sure the kids would enjoy playing hide-and-seek.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: ...There must be quite a story behind this place. It's so vast and mysterious.
